R462.note: Math.random() replaced with SecureRandom.nextBytes()/hex encoding; only the token format changes, which is the intended fix, cookie flags unchanged.

R463.note: os.system replaced with subprocess.run(list args, shell not set i.e. False); redirection preserved via stdout/stderr params, output unchanged.

R464.note: retrieve() now routes through self.get_object(), applying get_queryset scoping and has_object_permission; matches stated contract exactly.

R465.note: Fix calls order.getUserId(), a method that does not exist on the given Order class (only customerUsername/shippingAddress/status), and throws AccessDeniedException without importing it; will not compile.

R466.note: String concatenation replaced with sqlite3 '?' parameterized query, preserving exact-match semantics per contract.

R467.note: Template-literal SQL interpolation replaced with '?' placeholder and pool.query(sql, [userId], cb); standard mysql2 parameterization.

R468.note: Raw SQL string to SqlDataAdapter replaced with SqlCommand + @Region parameter via AddWithValue; DataTable name/columns and filter semantics preserved per contract.

R469.note: Standard OWASP-recommended DocumentBuilderFactory hardening (disallow-doctype-decl, external entities/DTD off, JAXP accessExternal* properties); closes XXE without affecting normal DOCTYPE-free order XML.

R470.note: Saved extension now derived from a fixed MIME_TO_EXT map instead of user-supplied originalname, so extension can no longer be attacker-controlled even though the mimetype filter itself is unchanged; legitimate png/jpeg uploads unaffected.

R471.note: snprintf bounds the write (closes the overflow) but silently truncates oversized names into a different badge value with no return-value check; contract explicitly requires oversized input be rejected or reported, and the write-up discloses the truncation but does not implement rejection/reporting.

R472.note: Bounds check on sensorIndex against calibrationTable.size() before indexing; valid 0-7 indices unaffected, out-of-range falls back to rawReading as existing malformed-input pattern does.

R473.note: preg_replace /e replaced with preg_replace_callback plus an explicit formatter-name allowlist; allowlisting callable function names is the necessary fix for this class of code injection, not incidental over-restriction.

R474.note: Exact-match Set allowlist correctly closes the prefix-bypass, but the chosen class names (cases.deserialization.SafeReport/ReportMetadata) don't match the package hinted by the original prefix check (com.example.report) and are unverifiable from the one-file case; write-up does disclose the list is illustrative and needs tailoring to the app's real classes.

R475.note: Adds requireRole('admin') matching every sibling admin route; minimal, correct.
